historical_run.model: Not reported: none of the image-to-3d, print-analyze or print-split task responses includes a model field. ai_model was omitted on the mesh stage, which followed the API default; the printability and Auto Split endpoints have no model selection.
historical_run.note: Two live runs, one per language, on September 27, 2026, from fresh copies of the repository, started 16 seconds apart. Each consumed 20 credits (image-to-3d with should_texture false, GLB only) + 0 credits (print-analyze on the model task) + 10 credits (print-split with target_formats glb and 3mf, layout on_plate, mode and connectors omitted), read from consumed_credits. Mesh stage 30.6-37.4 s from creation to finish; check 1.2 s; split 94.7-119.7 s; 139-173 s wall from start to files on disk. Both splits returned part_count 6. The check reported both meshes watertight with 0 holes and 0 non-manifold edges, status warning for 510,393-631,467 degenerate faces; a local count of the Python run's raw mesh found no zero-area triangles and exactly 510,393 triangles smaller than one square millimetre, so the metric counts tiny triangles.

artifact_inspection.method: Local file byte count and SHA-256; GLB JSON accessors and mesh/material/image/skin/animation arrays; 3MF objects, build items, component references and vertex extents parsed from the ZIP's model files with the standard library.
artifact_inspection.note: Python run artifacts (pictured). The TypeScript run produced a 21,394,020-byte, 1,069,452-triangle split GLB and a 14,339,231-byte 3MF with the same six parts on a 140.98 x 150.00 mm footprint, tallest part 139.84 mm. Both GLBs hold six meshes with POSITION and COLOR_0 attributes (one flat vertex color per part), no materials, no images, generator trimesh; the Python GLB's parts span 1.22 x 1.23 x 1.40 m in the on_plate layout. Both 3MFs are written by the Bambu Studio library (Application BambuStudio-02.03.01.00) in millimetres with the production extension: one build item, an object named meshy-split composed of six component parts (model_part0 to model_part5) in 3D/Objects/object_1.model, each assigned to its own extruder with a filament colour in Metadata/project_settings.config, placed at the centre of a 256 mm plate on a 144.84 x 150.00 mm footprint with every part resting on z = 0; the legs stand 131.91 mm tall on their hip cuts, the arms lie 98.7 mm long, the torso 104.7 x 67.3 x 49.7 mm and the head 40.3 x 35.4 x 27.6 mm. Model files are not published by this repository.
